limitations: All saved popup JPG frames viewed, not every runtime frame; actual variable timestamp intervals, no realtime 60fps viewing or performance assertion.
Only opening/arrival windows captured; full close/switch/reopen/refresh/expiry behavior not independently visually sequenced here, runtime assertions are supporting context only.
Raw root alpha/scale/y do not prove every child transform; complete-sheet and original image observations provide visual child synchronization evidence.
Some originals above 2048px auto-resized by viewer; originals preserved, complete frame visible. Contact sheets use uncut downscaled frames, and do not establish smallest Chinese glyph quality alone.
Victory/results popup clips are presentation fixtures; no Boss reward/idempotency claim from those clips.
Finite matrix states and scroll positions, not every possible string/seed/build/scroll row.
No desktop control, native automation, simulator changes, build, Player start, runtime edit or original capture edit.
Performance explicitly deferred by user; no 7200s/60fps/performance pass or complete-project conclusion.
